author: Numberz_
body:
I was going through an old flashdrive I had laying around and I found most of my old Minecraft files. I uploaded a hundred or so random screenshots that I found, I might upload the rest at the later date (I took TONS of screenshots back then, there are like 7 or 8 thousand  just on this drive).  I hope some of the images give you a little nostalgia and bring back some memories. Post some of your own memories if you have any lying around.

anyway here's the album link: http://imgur.com/a/8BeIr
